description: A long hall with a black-and-white tiled floor and a dado of brown glazed tile. A stone stair with a brass rail climbs past a birdcage lift that hasn't moved in years. Brass letter flaps are set into the wall in rows. To the south a bead curtain opens into Mixed Bag Variety Store, smelling of firelighters and boiled sweets.

window.description: A half-moon of coloured glass over the street door, the lead between the panes black with age. The light comes through it red and green on the tiles.
window.name: the fanlight
